# Honeybun Kidswear

> Sweet, comfy kidswear for little ones, sized 1 to 14 years. Payment is cash on delivery.

## Pages

- [Shop](https://www.honeybun.online/shop): every product, filterable by age and colour
- [Contact](https://www.honeybun.online/contact): WhatsApp and Instagram
- [Exchange policy](https://www.honeybun.online/exchanges): no refunds, exchanges within 7 days of delivery
